title: [Audit] 🗂️ Kibana Object Forensics
description: Every Kibana saved-object read and change, by type, name, space and identity.

config.content:
### Every change to your Kibana content, and who made it

Dashboards, visualizations, data views, alert rules, SLOs, workflows and other saved objects: what was created, edited, deleted or opened, in which space, and by whom. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

Use it to answer questions such as "Who deleted that dashboard?" or "What changed before the alert stopped firing?" Panels marked *noise gate applied* skip these audit dashboards' own activity, so you see your team's work.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Identity type, Identity or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. At the bottom, click a session bar or a session ID to replay that browser session step by step.

- *Noise gate applied* leaves out page loads, usage counters, paging and these dashboards’ own views and install; real changes, test spaces included, stay.
- Object is the title at the time, so a renamed object shows its old name on older rows; a workflow run reads “execution” and its run id.
- Spaces show by the id in their URL, not by name, which the audit log does not record. A sign-in belongs to no space.
- Click a session bar to pin that session and zoom to it; remove the pill and reset the time to return. Shift-click pins the identity.
- While a session is pinned, Elasticsearch panels read empty: only browser sign-ins carry a session id, so API-only identities have no bars.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown, a Cloud API key shortened to “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”. The dropdowns apply to this page only; the links above do not carry them.

config.description: All Kibana audit events: a small share of the stream, but where saved objects, spaces and sessions are recorded. The line above the number compares it with the prior period of the same length.
